title: Implement bounded MM-09 authoritative transport gaps
steps: Reconcile the MM-09 protocol reference, server authority fixture and current Godot client boundaries.
Identify the smallest missing implementation needed for authenticated session ownership, deck locking, intent/event flow, reconnect or replay recovery.
Implement one bounded transport/authority capability without moving rules into UI code or claiming a hosted production service.
Add deterministic protocol, authorization, disconnect and replay regression tests.
Document hosted-service, identity, retention and operations work as separate external gates.
acceptance: A bounded MM-09 implementation gap is closed with deterministic evidence and no false claim of hosted online production readiness.
